eldora.note: Eldora is closed for the summer. 26/27 Alpine season passes are on sale now! Prices increase on October 22nd . Shop now HERE for the best pricing. Thanks for a great season! We'll see you in November!

copper mountain.note: Last chair has been called, and Copper Mountain is now closed for the 2025-26 winter season. Thank you for being a part of a memorable year on the slopes! While snowfall didn’t always cooperate, there were still plenty of great days to be had across the mountain. You all showed up, made the most of every run, and helped make it a season worth celebrating. We're already looking forward to next winter, with hopes of more powder days than we can handle and classic Colorado bluebird days peppered in. Until then, the fun doesn't stop. Join us this summer for golf at Copper Creek, downhill bike park laps, and a full lineup of great summer activities and events culminating with the Union Peak Festival in late August. We look forward to seeing you this summer and again next winter!

snowbird.note: Oktoberfest has concluded for the year. Thanks for coming out to polka with us. We are currently in shoulder season. The hiking and biking trails remain open. Summer Activities and the Scenic Tram are closed for the season. The Tram is scheduled to reopen in winter. Speaking of winter, save the date. Opening Day is scheduled for November 27, conditions dependent. Still want some mountain time? The Cliff Spa is open, so you can treat yourself to a relaxing massage before taking a dip in the rooftop pool. Many of Snowbird's restaurants are also operating throughout the week. Enjoy a decadent steak at the Steak Pit or enjoy the view from the 10th floor of The Cliff Lodge at The Aerie . Can't wait to see you up here!
